title: Japan Launches New Satellite to Improve Navigation System
titleZh: 日本发射新卫星以改进导航系统
credits: Mari Yamaguchi reported this story for the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: Japan's space agency says it successfully launched a navigation satellite on its new H3 rocket.
sentences.zh: 日本航天机构表示，它已成功用新型H3火箭发射了一颗导航卫星。

sentences.en: The latest launch on February 2 took place as the country aims to develop a more precise positioning system.
sentences.zh: 2月2日进行的最新发射正值该国致力于开发更精确的定位系统。

sentences.en: The H3 rocket carrying the Michibiki 6 satellite lifted off from the Tanegashima Space Center on a southwestern Japanese island.
sentences.zh: 搭载'密子6号'卫星的H3火箭从日本西南部岛屿上的种子岛宇宙中心发射升空。

sentences.en: Makoto Arita oversees the H3 project for the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency known as JAXA.
sentences.zh: 荒田诚负责日本宇宙航空研究开发机构（简称JAXA）的H3项目。

sentences.en: Arita said everything went smoothly and the satellite successfully separated from the rocket as planned about 29 minutes after liftoff.
sentences.zh: 荒田表示，一切顺利，卫星按计划在发射后约29分钟成功与火箭分离。

sentences.en: Officials said it should reach its target orbit around Earth in the middle of February.
sentences.zh: 官员称，该卫星应在2月中旬进入绕地球的目标轨道。

sentences.en: Japan’s current system is called the quasi-zenith satellite system, or QZSS.
sentences.zh: 日本现行系统称为准天顶卫星系统，简称QZSS。

sentences.en: It started operating in 2018 and has four satellites that serve a regional navigation system.
sentences.zh: 该系统于2018年投入使用，拥有4颗卫星，作为区域导航系统运行。

sentences.en: The Michibiki 6 will be the fifth satellite in the network.
sentences.zh: '密子6号'将成为该网络的第五颗卫星。

sentences.en: Michibiki's signals are used to supplement the American satellite system called the Global Positioning System (GPS).
sentences.zh: '密子'的信号用于补充被称为全球定位系统（GPS）的美国卫星系统。

sentences.en: It will also improve positioning data for smartphones, car navigation, navigation at sea and drones.
sentences.zh: 它还将为智能手机、汽车导航、海上导航和无人机提供更精确的定位数据。

sentences.en: Japan plans to launch two more navigation satellites to have a seven-satellite system by March 2026.
sentences.zh: 日本计划再发射两颗导航卫星，到2026年3月建成由7颗卫星组成的系统。

sentences.en: The Japan Science and Technology Agency hopes that will create a more precise global positioning ability without depending on foreign services, including GPS.
sentences.zh: 日本科学技术振兴机构希望由此实现不依赖包括GPS在内的外国服务更精确的全球定位能力。

sentences.en: By the late 2030s, Japan plans to have an 11-satellite network.
sentences.zh: 到2030年代末，日本计划建成由11颗卫星组成的网络。

sentences.en: Sunday's launch was the fourth successful flight in a row for the H3 system.
sentences.zh: 周日的发射是H3系统的连续第四次成功飞行。

sentences.en: The first attempt to launch last year failed and the rocket had to be destroyed with its payload.
sentences.zh: 去年首次发射失败，火箭不得不连同其载荷一起被摧毁。

sentences.en: Japan considers the ability to regularly put satellites into orbit as important to its space program and national security.
sentences.zh: 日本认为定期将卫星送入轨道的能力对其太空计划和国家安全至关重要。

sentences.en: It has been developing two new leading rockets.
sentences.zh: 日本正在研发两种新型主力火箭。

sentences.en: One is the large H3 from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
sentences.zh: 一种是三菱重工生产的大型H3火箭。

sentences.en: The other is a much smaller Epsilon system with the aerospace unit of IHI corporation.
sentences.zh: 另一种是IHI公司航空部门生产的规模小得多的'厄普西龙'（Epsilon）系统。

sentences.en: Japan hopes to meet the needs of companies for space launch services and improve its position in the growing satellite launch market.
sentences.zh: 日本希望满足企业对于航天发射服务的需求，并在不断扩大的卫星发射市场中提升自身地位。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。
